##### Project general facts

Verona at Damac Hills 2 is a townhouse development by DAMAC Properties, offering a refined residential experience that blends classic inspiration with modern living. Designed as a family-oriented community, the project provides a peaceful suburban setting while maintaining access to Dubai’s key destinations, creating a balanced lifestyle focused on comfort and privacy.

The development features spacious four-bedroom townhouses with thoughtfully designed layouts that prioritize both functionality and elegance. Each home includes generous indoor spaces and a private garden, encouraging a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle ideal for family living, relaxation, and social gatherings within a tranquil environment.

Interiors are finished with premium materials and high-quality detailing, enhancing the overall sense of comfort and sophistication. Kitchens come fully equipped, and the homes are semi-furnished, offering a practical and ready-to-live-in space while still allowing for personal customization.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills 2 have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills 2 offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
